guards.rationale: PROMPT.md bug class 13's trace: the sim also clears at the point of use (fake_venerable_tea_set.py:31), and neither side clears at a combat boundary. That is correct on both sides -- the flag has to survive from the rest site through the map to the next fight, which is precisely why a combat-boundary reset would break it.
